mandate: C317 — test the cross-sectional REALIZED-VOLATILITY / HIGHER-MOMENT statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -risk, long low/short high): rv (trailing std), ivol (idio-vol vs xsec mean), skew (trailing skewness), maxret (trailing MAX single-bar return), dsvol (downside semivariance). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and low-volatility-vs-lottery-vs-downside-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.signals: rv=trailing-L std(log_return); ivol=trailing-L std(log_return - xsec_mean); skew=trailing-L skewness(log_return); maxret=trailing-L max(log_return); dsvol=sqrt(trailing-L mean(min(r,0)^2)); score=-risk (long low/short high); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i (pos>0 long).
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite returns treated as NaN; never impute; a lookback without enough valid observations yields NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config vs low-vol(rv)/lottery(skew)/downside(dsvol) vs placebo (per-asset randomly permuted perp returns, same reference positions); shares = |net| / sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
